stations.title: Odette
stations.say: Why does the show column say Tea?
stations.note: Tea, Toast and Tunes is new.

stations.title: Listings screen
stations.text: Cuts each line of listings at its commas.

stations.title: Cupboard server
stations.text: Now answers the listings as JSON too.

captions: Odette asks why the new Friday show is split across two columns on the listings screen.
The screen cuts each line at its commas, and the new show has commas in its name.
You read the listings as JSON, and only when the server says it is JSON, in three tasks.
The show comes through whole, with its name, time and presenter each in place.
Part 2 begins: data travels as JSON, and the content-type says what a body is.
